meta.title: Batch local plugin install
meta.description: Adds two entrances to Settings → Plugins: a "Batch install" tab and an "Install from folder…" row in the Add menu. Pick a folder with the harness's own native directory chooser (no path typing); the host half lists the dsh plugin packages inside it (package.json with dsh.bundle.patch, or a legacy manifest.json), the page marks each as installed / installable / legacy, and ticking them installs them one after another through the plugin manager's own installBundle, reporting ok, restart-required, or failure per row.
